# KINEGuard public Atlas map

This is documentation, not the KINEGuard runtime.

- README.md: product thesis, walkthrough, evidence boundaries, screenshots
- docs/capability-matrix.md: one evidence class per consumer control
- docs/capability-catalog.json: machine-readable capability catalog
- evidence/claim-to-evidence.md: claim provenance and limitations
- evidence/screenshot-manifest.md: screenshot source, redaction, and status
- docs/deep-dives/: wallet, browser, timing, veto, exposure, governance, agents
- mechanisms/: nine customer-facing controls
- docs/en/kine-ai.md: KAI-00 through KAI-09 roadmap
- docs/product-surface.md: public and controlled surfaces
- docs/evidence-and-proofs.md: historical GP1A and V3 evidence
- docs/security-boundaries.md: non-overclaiming rules

Evidence classes: LIVE VERIFIED, TESTNET VERIFIED, LAB / CI VERIFIED, UI / READ-ONLY, DESIGN / ROADMAP.
Do not treat local screenshots, CI, historical Sepolia, or visible UI as proof of current production enforcement.
